semantic_review.reason: The Lean proof reduces the actual mean gap to 1/606. Independent Fraction evaluation gives low=605/303, high=403/202, gap=1/606, and (1/2)/(1/606)=303.

scope: A family with known a=e=1 and b=1+eps approaches the degeneracy b=e. The parameter difference stays 1/2 while its exact population-mean difference tends to zero.
limits: The rate b varies across the family; this is not a failure of injectivity at a fixed b unequal to e.
The module compares means only and does not bound any distance between the full output distributions.
The ratio 303 is a finite difference quotient between the stated two f values, not a derivative evaluated at one f.
There is no finite-sample estimator or sampling-error theorem.
